name: Velocity fraud rule
logic: count of payments per customer in window > fraud_velocity_threshold (5) within fraud_window_seconds (300); alert at count == threshold+1
plain: Flag a customer who makes more than 5 payments in 5 minutes; alert once per window

name: Amount z-score fraud rule
logic: abs(amount_eur - mean)/std > fraud_amount_zscore (3.0) over last 200 payments per customer
plain: Flag a payment more than 3 standard deviations from the customer's usual amount

name: Geo mismatch fraud rule
plain: Flag a payment whose billing country differs from the merchant's country

name: Fraud thresholds live in configuration
logic: fraud_velocity_threshold=5, fraud_window_seconds=300, fraud_amount_zscore=3.0; `x or settings.x` means an explicit 0 falls back
plain: Fraud sensitivity is set by environment variables, not code; nobody named owns them

name: Silver pseudonymization
logic: sha256('{salt}:' || arg_max(email, occurred_at)); same for iban
plain: Email and IBAN are replaced by a salted hash of the latest value; same input gives same hash

name: Consent = AND over all orders
logic: bool_and(marketing_consent) GROUP BY customer_id over all bronze.orders
plain: A customer counts as consenting only if every order ever placed carried consent; a later opt-in never overrides an old opt-out

name: Order/payment dedup tie-break
logic: row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY occurred_at) = 1
plain: When an order arrives twice, keep the earliest version

name: Incremental watermark on event time
logic: WHERE occurred_at > watermark; watermark = max(bronze.orders.occurred_at), reused for payments
plain: Each run only processes events newer than the newest order seen; late events are skipped

name: Erasure masks Bronze, deletes Silver/Gold/fraud alerts
logic: UPDATE bronze.* SET email/iban/ip_address='<anonymized>'; DELETE silver.*, gold.*, bronze.fraud_alerts WHERE customer_id=?
plain: On erasure the raw rows stay with PII overwritten; derived rows are deleted

name: Suppression honoured at Silver rebuild
logic: build_silver: DELETE FROM silver.customers; INSERT … FROM bronze.orders GROUP BY customer_id — no suppression_registry filter
plain: Docs say an erased customer stays suppressed; the full rebuild re-creates them from masked Bronze rows

conflicts.note: suppression registry presented as the guard against re-ingest

name: Quality gate blocks publication
logic: quality_gate runs after build_gold; failure only blocks export_lake
plain: Docs say a failed check aborts the DAG; in code Silver/Gold are already overwritten when the gate runs

name: Consent quality check
logic: count(*) FROM gold.customer_360 WHERE consents_marketing <> marketing_consent, both from the same column
plain: The consent check can never fail; it does not test the suppression registry or upstream consent

conflicts.note: 'quality gate checks that transformations preserve the flag'

name: PII column classification
logic: majority vote ≥ 0.6 over sampled values; IBAN mod-97 for 11 country codes; gate samples 200 bronze.orders rows only
plain: New columns are flagged as PII when 60% of a sample looks like PII; only the orders feed is scanned

name: /stats falls back to the public HF lake
logic: if local total == 0: read hf://datasets/swadhinbiswas/eustream/*.parquet; silver/orders count mapped to key silver_customers
plain: When the local warehouse is empty the dashboard shows numbers from the public dataset, one of them mislabelled

name: /fraud_alerts falls back to gold summary
plain: If raw alerts cannot be read, the endpoint silently returns the aggregate instead

name: Erasure audit status always 'completed'
logic: status='completed' set unconditionally; Turso errors logged as warning; 'lake' added to layers_touched before the callback runs
plain: The audit can say an erasure is complete when a remote copy or the lake refresh failed

name: Streaming suppression check
logic: suppression_check=erasure.is_suppressed passed to the processor; set seeded once at construction
plain: A running fraud processor only learns of new erasures made in its own process

conflicts.note: says streaming stops 'immediately'; README says not refreshed automatically

name: Default consent
plain: An event that carries no consent flag is treated as not consenting
